seo.meta_description: Full Cook Out menu with prices and calories for 2026: the Cook Out Tray, char-grilled burgers, BBQ, hush puppies, corn dogs and 40-plus milkshakes.

price_disclaimer: Prices and calories are approximate, are provided as a guide only, and may vary by location. Cook Out is a privately held Southern chain and does not publish full nutrition, so some calorie figures are estimates. Last updated October 2026.
intro: Cook Out is the Southern drive-thru chain famous for the Cook Out Tray, which pairs a main with two sides and a drink for a low fixed price, and for its 40-plus hand-dipped milkshake flavors. The menu runs from char-grilled burgers and BBQ to hot dogs, chicken, quesadillas, hush puppies and corn dogs, nearly all at value prices. Below is the full Cook Out menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: A Cook Out Tray (a main plus two sides and a drink) is about $5.29, a regular hamburger is $2.99, and a BBQ sandwich is $3.19. Hot dogs, corn dogs and hush puppies are about $1.00, and a milkshake is $2.99 with over 40 flavors. The Cook Out Tray and the milkshakes are the signatures.

hot_deal: Cook Out value: the whole chain is built on value, and the Cook Out Tray (about $5.29) for a main, two sides and a drink is one of the best deals in fast food. Dollar items (hot dogs, corn dogs, hush puppies, chicken nuggets) round out a cheap meal. A milkshake is $2.99 for any of 40-plus flavors. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is the Cook Out Tray?
faqs.a: The Cook Out Tray is the signature value order: a main (like a hamburger, chicken strips or a quesadilla) plus two sides and a drink for one low fixed price, about $5.29. It is the cheapest full meal on the menu.

faqs.q: How many milkshake flavors does Cook Out have?
faqs.a: Cook Out has over 40 hand-dipped milkshake flavors, from classics like vanilla and chocolate to Cheesecake, Banana Pudding, Peanut Butter Fudge and seasonal options. Each is about $2.99, which is part of the chain's cult following.

faqs.q: How much is a burger at Cook Out?
faqs.a: A regular hamburger is about $2.99 and a Cheddar Style burger is $3.99. Nearly everything is cheap: hot dogs, corn dogs and hush puppies are about $1.00 each, and a full Cook Out Tray is around $5.29.

faqs.q: Does Cook Out publish nutrition information?
faqs.a: Cook Out is a privately held chain and does not publish a full nutrition table, so calorie figures are estimates. A regular burger is roughly 328 calories and a BBQ sandwich about 368, but milkshakes vary widely by flavor.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Cook Out?
faqs.a: The best known are the Cook Out Tray, the 40-plus milkshakes, the Cheddar Style burger, the BBQ sandwich, and the hush puppies.
